Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hi,
A question rose yesterday:
Suppose I control Muricia and 2 !Gangrels.
During my untap phase, can they both become Ahrimanes (in the same
untap phase, that would be)?

I suppose they can't.
Indeed, Code of Samiel has the same grammatical structure (During your
untap phase, a [something you control] [does magic]) - and it's pretty
clear that Code of Samiel's intent is not to give each !Salubri 1
blood each untap phase.

Thanks,

~~

Muricia
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Ahrimane
Group: 4
Capacity: 7
Discipline: ANI PRE SPI
Sabbat: During your untap phase, a Gangrel antitribu you control may
burn 1 blood to become a sterile Ahrimane and gain 1 level of
Spiritus. +1 strength. Sterile.

Code of Samiel
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Salubri antitribu
Cost: 2 pool
Burn Option
Unique master.
Put this card in play. During your untap phase, a Salubri antitribu
you control gains 1 blood. When a Salubri antitribu burns a ready
vampire or sends a vampire to torpor in combat or as a (D) action, he
or she untaps after the end of the minion phase.
